binding: All per-suite source/test/config hashes were checked against this final candidate. No source change occurred between the passing original suites and the final new-chapter repeat. Both full six-suite runs passed110 unaffected cases and28 new cases; the one failed saved-help test helper was repaired, then all29 new-chapter cases repeated in each channel. No failed case is counted as passing.
mechanisms: Installed Chrome155 and Edge155, playwright-core, disposable synthetic profiles; native IndexedDB, service-worker cache, browser network disable; NODE_ENV=test interaction renderer. Separate production UI review certifies the actual production rendering sample.
